description: This file contains a series of automated tests for the 'git gc' command, verifying its behavior under various conditions and configurations. It uses a testing framework with functions like 'test_expect_success', 'test_cmp', and 'test_grep' to validate outputs and side effects.

methods.name: prepare_cruft_history
methods.description: Sets up a repository with specific commits and resets for testing cruft pack behaviors.

methods.name: assert_no_cruft_packs
methods.description: Checks that no cruft packs (unnecessary or outdated pack files) are present in the repository.

methods.name: run_and_wait_for_gc
methods.description: Runs 'git gc' in the background, captures its output, and waits for the process to complete.
